description: Wire a Lakebase PostgreSQL backend into an existing AppKit project. Covers database schema design from a PRD, idempotent DDL, Express API routes with mock fallback, React data hooks, and local testing. PRD-independent patterns that apply to any AppKit + Lakebase app. Use after registering the Lakebase plugin via 04-appkit-plugin-add. Triggers on "wire lakebase", "lakebase backend", "CRUD API", "lakebase tables", "DDL", "database schema design", "useLakebaseData", "mock fallback", "ConnectionStatus", "replace mock data", "connect frontend to backend", "API-backed data", "replace static data with database".
